            A fresh set. Whenever you want.

            The rules

            A word at a time.

            1. Use every letter to make a word. Tap the tiles or type. Valid alternative anagrams count.
            2. You get 30 seconds per word. Unused seconds don’t carry over.
            3. Use Shuffle once per word. Tap a selected letter to erase from its last occurrence onward. Backspace removes the last letter; Clear removes all. Use Space as a shortcut for Shuffle and Ctrl+Backspace for Clear.
            4. Miss a word? We’ll reveal the answer and move on. Your score is how many you solve out of 20.
            THE SAME CLIMB, EVERY TIME

            2 × 4 letters → 5 × 5 → 6 × 6 → 3 × 7 → 2 × 8 → 1 × 9 → 1 × 10

            Solo pauses when you switch apps and starts fresh on reload. Battle never pauses. Both players get the same words; the first correct answer received by the server earns 1 point. Answers received less than 0.2 seconds apart tie, earning 0.5 points each. Both must arrive before time runs out. If neither player solves, neither scores. Each round ends with a two-second reveal. The highest score takes the match.

            About this game

            More room for wordplay.

            Battle Words is an independent anagram game with unlimited solo play and two-player battles, inspired by 18words. A new set of twenty words is chosen at the start of every game. Repeated words are possible.

            Puzzles use a smaller word list. A broader dictionary still accepts less-common anagrams using your letters.

            Words from SCOWL; grammatical information from the English Speller Database (ESDB).

            An internet connection is required to load the game and play battles. Solo progress lasts only while this page is loaded. Battle remembers your name and player seat in this browser. Reopen the room link here to rejoin; clearing browser data loses your seat. Completed battle results are visible to anyone with the link.
